_Last updated: 2026-06-22 (sprint 429 - **BUG FIX: mode switch failed from any non-perfil section (only worked from "Mi perfil")** (`landing-navbar.tsx` `switchMode`). **Cause:** `switchMode` did `setMode(next)` then `router.push("?tab=profile")` (a NEUTRAL/shared tab). The panel derives `mode` from the URL tab — `urlForcedMode = OFFER_ONLY.has(tab) ? "offer" : USE_ONLY.has(tab) ? "use" : null` — and a `useEffect` FORCES `globalMode` to match it. So when you switched FROM a mode-specific tab (e.g. `bookings`/Solicitudes recibidas, an OFFER_ONLY tab), `setMode("use")` fired, but the panel re-rendered while still on `bookings` → the guard saw `urlForcedMode="offer" !== global="use"` → `setMode("offer")`, REVERTING the switch; navigation then landed on `profile` (neutral, `urlForcedMode=null`) so nothing corrected the revert → mode stuck on the old one. From "Mi perfil" (neutral, no forcing) there was no revert → it "worked" only there. **Fix:** `switchMode` now lands on the **NEW mode's MAIN section — a mode-SPECIFIC tab**, not neutral `profile`: **offer → `?tab=bookings` (Solicitudes recibidas)**, **use → `?tab=sent_bookings` (Mis solicitudes)**. Now the panel's guard REINFORCES the new mode on arrival (the destination tab's forced mode == the new mode) so the switch always sticks from ANY section, the toggle reflects the new mode, and you land somewhere useful. tsc + next build clean. **Live-verify: from Solicitudes recibidas (or any section) tap "Cliente" → the whole experience flips to client mode, the toggle shows Cliente active (not stuck), and you land on "Mis solicitudes"; tap "Profesional" from any client section → flips to pro, lands on "Solicitudes recibidas"; works from every section, not just Mi perfil; ~360px; EN.**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-22 (sprint 420 - **Mobile bottom-nav: fixed the auto-scroll interfering with "Más"; confirmed the fixed-bar + "Más" overflow pattern** (`dashboard/profesional/page.tsx`, design guide). **(1) Auto-scroll fix:** `setTab` used a **smooth `scrollIntoView`** on the content ref which fought the fixed mobile bottom bar — the bar's `backdrop-blur` made the **"Más" item flicker / feel covered** during the animated scroll. Now `setTab` does an **instant `window.scrollTo({ top: 0 })`** (no smooth animation, window-based), and **tapping the current tab just closes "Más" and no-ops** (`if (tab === activeTab) return`). The bottom bar is now a **solid white surface** (dropped `bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md` → `bg-white` + a subtle top shadow `shadow-[0_-2px_10px_...]`) so it stays rock-solid during momentum scroll. **(2) "Más" vs horizontal scroll — KEPT "Más":** modern apps (Instagram/WhatsApp/Twitter) use a FIXED 4–5-item bar + a "Más"/overflow, NOT a horizontally-scrolling bottom bar (users don't realize they can scroll it; it feels unstable). The **"Más" item (••• `MoreHorizontal` + label)** is the discoverable affordance that opens the remaining sections in a bottom sheet — confirmed as the right pattern. tsc + next build clean. **Live-verify (mobile): tapping a bottom-nav section switches content with an instant jump to the top — the fixed bar + "Más" stay fully visible/tappable (no flicker, nothing covered); "Más" opens the overflow sheet; the bar never scrolls horizontally; ~360px.**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-22 (sprint 410 - **Fix: mouse-wheel now scrolls INSIDE the "Fecha de nacimiento" dropdown (and every SelectMenu list inside a modal)** (`select-menu.tsx`, ONE effect). With the cursor inside an open DOB día/mes/año dropdown, the wheel did nothing. **Cause (same family as the sprint-404 pointer-events bug):** the `SelectMenu` option list is **portaled to `<body>`**, OUTSIDE the booking modal's Radix `Dialog.Content`, which wraps its content in **`react-remove-scroll`**. That lib attaches a **non-passive `wheel` listener on `window`/`document`** and `preventDefault()`s wheel events whose target is OUTSIDE the modal — so the portaled list's native `overflow-y-auto` scroll was cancelled (the page is also locked → "nothing happens"). **Fix:** attach a **native `wheel` listener on the list element** (keyed on `open`+`pos`) that calls **`e.stopPropagation()`**. react-remove-scroll listens in the **bubble** phase on window/document, so the list (the event target) receives the wheel FIRST; stopping propagation there means react-remove-scroll never sees it and never cancels it → the list scrolls natively (the existing `overscroll-contain` stops scroll-chaining; the modal's body-lock keeps the page still). Harmless outside a dialog (just keeps the page from scrolling while hovering an open list). The rest of the picker is unaffected (selecting día/mes/año, year list, dd/mm/yyyy) for both "para mí" and "para otra persona". tsc + next build clean. **Live-verify: open Solicitar servicio for a medical service → open the "Fecha de nacimiento" Año dropdown → put the cursor inside it → the mouse wheel scrolls the year list (not the page); picking a date still works in both para mí and para otra persona; ~360px; EN.**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-21 (sprint 406 - **Adopted the FULL Airbnb mode model — one switch flips the ENTIRE experience (cliente ↔ profesional), per-mode notifications** (`hooks/use-mode.ts` NEW, `landing-navbar.tsx`, `notification-bell.tsx`, `notifications-list.tsx`, `notification-link.ts`, `dashboard/profesional/page.tsx`, messages es+en, design guide). Default for a provider = "offer". **(2) The switch lives in the NAVBAR account menu** (desktop + mobile drawer), Airbnb-style: **"Cambiar a modo profesional" / "Cambiar a modo cliente"** (`ArrowLeftRight`), and the **whole menu becomes the active world** — offer: Mi panel · **Solicitudes recibidas** (`?tab=bookings`) · **Mis propuestas** (`?tab=proposals`); use: Mi panel · Mis solicitudes · Mis solicitudes publicadas · Guardados — under a **"Modo profesional"/"Modo cliente"** eyebrow. **(3) Removed the in-panel segmented toggle** (the coexisting-sections UI); the panel now shows a quiet **"Modo …"** label in the header and READS the global mode. Deep-link tabs (offer-only/use-only, e.g. a notification href or a navbar quick link) still **force** their mode and **persist it globally** (a `useEffect` adopts `urlForcedMode`), keeping the navbar switch + bell in sync; `setTab` no longer needs a `?mode=` param. **(4) Per-mode notifications** — new `notificationInMode(type, mode)` (professional→offer, client→use, support/unknown→both). The ambiguous "Ver todas" is **resolved naturally** (single mode now) → one unambiguous **"Ver todas"** (new `notifications.viewAll`, bilingual — was hardcoded Spanish). **(5) Other-mode awareness WITHOUT switching** — the navbar fetches unread `type`s and buckets them (pro/client/neutral); a small **unread-count badge on the "Cambiar a modo …" item** shows the OTHER world's pending count (active-mode count = own + neutral; other-mode badge = the other world's pure count). **(6) One account** throughout; a client-only user still sees **"Ofrecer mis servicios"** to activate. **NO email notifications added** (in-app + WhatsApp only; Brevo free-plan burst risk). tsc + next build clean; JSON valid; no voseo. _Last updated: 2026-06-21 (sprint 404 - **REAL ROOT-CAUSE FIX: the "Fecha de nacimiento" picker in Solicitar servicio was unclickable inside the modal — `pointer-events: none` from the Radix modal, NOT modal-dismissal** (`select-menu.tsx`, ONE line). The DOB picker would not let you select a date for BOTH "para mí" AND "para otra persona" — sprint 395's fix (dismiss guards) did NOT work because it targeted the wrong cause. **Diagnosis (proven, not guessed):** the booking modal (`booking-modal.tsx`) is a **Radix MODAL `Dialog.Content`**; the SAME `SelectMenu` (provincia/cantón) works fine in `publish-project-modal.tsx`, which is a **plain `<div className="fixed inset-0">` modal** — so the differentiator is Radix. A modal `Dialog.Content` renders a `DismissableLayer` with **`disableOutsidePointerEvents`**, which sets **`document.body { pointer-events: none }`** while open and re-enables pointer events ONLY on the dialog layer. The `SelectMenu` **portals its `<div role="listbox">` to `document.body`** (so it isn't clipped) — OUTSIDE that layer — so it inherited **`pointer-events: none`**: the dropdown OPENED (trigger button is inside the dialog → clickable) but every día/mes/año option was **pointer-dead**, clicks passed through, `onClick`/`onChange` never fired = "won't let me select a date". **Why prior fixes failed:** they assumed clicking an option DISMISSED the modal and added `onPointerDownOutside`/`onInteractOutside`/`onFocusOutside` + `stopPropagation` — but with `pointer-events:none` NO pointer event ever fired from the list, so there was nothing to dismiss and nothing for those guards to catch; the clicks simply never landed. **Fix (root cause, 1 line):** added **`pointerEvents: "auto"`** to the portaled listbox `style` in `select-menu.tsx`, so the list is interactive despite the inert body. Now the option click fires (selects día/mes/año, dd/mm/yyyy, easy year scroll) AND the pre-existing `data-selectmenu-list` dismiss guards finally matter (they keep the modal open now that the pointerdown actually reaches `document`). This ALSO fixes every other `SelectMenu` inside a Radix modal (e.g. `client-registration-modal.tsx`). tsc + next build clean. **Live-verify: medical service → "para mí" AND "para otra persona" → the Fecha de nacimiento día/mes/año dropdowns OPEN and the option click REGISTERS (value set, modal stays open) → booking completes; overlay-click/Escape still close the modal; ~360px; EN.**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-21 (sprint 395 - **CRITICAL BUG fix: the beneficiary "Fecha de nacimiento" picker in Solicitar servicio was unselectable — the Radix Dialog dismissed itself on each dropdown-option click** (`booking-modal.tsx`, `select-menu.tsx`). **Cause:** the booking modal is a **Radix `Dialog.Content`** (modal); the DOB picker's day/month/year `SelectMenu` dropdowns **portal their option list to `<body>`** (outside the dialog) so they aren't clipped. Clicking an option registered as an **"interaction outside" the dialog → Radix dismissed the whole modal**, so the picker read as "broken / won't let me select". The existing `stopPropagation` on the portal wasn't enough (Radix's `usePointerDownOutside` listens on `document`; React-portal event ordering let it still fire). **Why beneficiary specifically:** the SELF DOB is normally **auto-filled from the cédula/padrón**, so its picker is rarely operated manually; the **beneficiary (otra persona) has no cédula**, so its DOB MUST be picked manually — exposing the dismiss bug. **Fix (canonical Radix pattern):** mark the SelectMenu portal list with **`data-selectmenu-list`**, and on the booking modal's `Dialog.Content` add **`onPointerDownOutside`/`onInteractOutside`/`onFocusOutside`** handlers (`keepSelectMenuOpen`) that **`preventDefault()` ONLY when the interaction target is inside `[data-selectmenu-list]`** — so option clicks/focus never dismiss the modal, while a normal overlay click / Escape still closes it. Works for BOTH self and beneficiary DOB (day · month · year, dd/mm/yyyy, easy year scroll). tsc + next build clean. **Live-verify: medical service for OTRA PERSONA → the beneficiary "Fecha de nacimiento" day/month/year selects open AND register the pick (modal stays open) → can complete the booking; self DOB (manual, no cédula) also works; overlay-click/Escape still close the modal; ~360px; EN.**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-21 (sprint 390 - **Implemented AUTO-CONFIRM bookings + atomic double-booking index + pro cancel-with-reason / reschedule tools + new status filters** (`migrations/069`, `api/bookings`, `lib/notifications.ts`, `lib/notification-link.ts`, `status-filter-tabs.tsx`, `booking-requests.tsx`, `client-activity.tsx`, messages es+en, design guide). **(1) Auto-confirm:** `api/bookings` POST now inserts `status:"confirmed"` (was "pending") — a solicitud in an available slot confirms instantly + holds the slot; NO manual accept. Applies to EVERYONE incl. no-cédula clients (no separate approval flow). **(2) Atomic guard (migration 069):** partial unique index `bookings_active_slot_uidx` on `(professional_id, scheduled_date, scheduled_time) WHERE status IN ('pending','confirmed','in_progress') AND scheduled_date IS NOT NULL AND scheduled_time IS NOT NULL`. POST keeps the fast-path clash check AND now catches 23505 → 409; PATCH (reschedule) catches 23505 → 409 too. **⚠️ OWNER MUST RUN migration 069.** **(3) Pro tools (booking-requests panel):** replaced the accept/pending buttons with — for any ACTIVE booking — **Marcar realizado** · **Reprogramar** (inline date+time → PATCH `scheduledDate/scheduledTime`, client notified via new `notifyBookingRescheduled`) · **Cancelar** (inline panel: 3 preset reason chips + free-text → PATCH `status:cancelled, cancelReason`; client notified WITH the motivo via extended `notifyBookingStatusChange(…, reason)`; frees the slot). WhatsApp button already present. **(4) Unverified visibility:** a **"Sin verificar"** grey chip next to the client name when no `client_cedula` (the pro decides → contact / cancel). **(5) Status filters:** SOLICITUD_TABS dropped "Pendientes" → **Confirmadas · Finalizadas · Canceladas** (default Confirmadas; `solicitudBucket` maps legacy `pending`→confirmadas; `client-activity` bookingFilter default → confirmadas); PROYECTO_TABS unchanged (4 buckets — Pendientes still real for open proyectos / pending propuestas). **(6) Copy:** booking success → **"¡Solicitud confirmada! … Coordina los detalles directamente por WhatsApp con el profesional."** (honest — "confirmada" = reserved, not approved). New i18n `bookingRequests.{reschedule,cancelTitle,cancelHint,cancelR1..3,cancelReasonPlaceholder,cancelConfirm,reschedTitle,reschedDateLabel,reschedTimeLabel,reschedConfirm,reschedNeed,reschedError,reschedHint,back,unverified}` + `notifications.types.booking_rescheduled`. `booking_rescheduled` added to client notification context. tsc + next build clean; JSON valid. **MIGRATION SQL to run:** `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS bookings_active_slot_uidx ON public.bookings (professional_id, scheduled_date, scheduled_time) WHERE status IN ('pending','confirmed','in_progress') AND scheduled_date IS NOT NULL AND scheduled_time IS NOT NULL;` **Live-verify (after migration): book a slot → instantly "Confirmada" + WhatsApp; pro sees it with Reprogramar/Cancelar; cancel-with-reason notifies client + frees slot; reschedule proposes new time; concurrent same-slot → 409; no-cédula client shows "Sin verificar" but still auto-confirms; tabs = Confirmadas/Finalizadas/Canceladas; ~360px; EN.**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-21 (sprint 389 - **RECOMMENDATION (analysis only, NO code): make solicitudes AUTO-CONFIRM (hybrid), + add an atomic slot unique index — awaiting owner decision** (no files changed). Question: should a solicitud require pro ACCEPT or be automatic? **Key finding that reframes it:** the slot is ALREADY occupied at REQUEST time, not at acceptance — `api/bookings` POST rejects a new request (409 "Ese horario acaba de ser reservado") when an active booking (`pending|confirmed|in_progress`) holds that pro+date+time, and the public `takenFor` feed hides the slot for those SAME statuses incl. **pending**; the client also gets a **WhatsApp button immediately** on the success screen (contact isn't gated by accept); the pro's "accept" is just `pending→confirmed` and **Cancel frees the slot in either state**. So today's accept-required model is the WORST combo: a pending request blocks the slot AND still demands an accept click (friction with NO added protection; an ignored request blocks the pro's own slot for nothing). **RECOMMENDED: AUTO-CONFIRM** — a solicitud in an available slot auto-confirms + occupies the slot (already the behavior) + client-cancel frees it (already works); the pro keeps the one-tap **"Liberar horario"/Cancelar** as the control lever (rename to read as "free the slot"). Fits the connector model (real coordination is on WhatsApp, available instantly; in-app accept is ceremony). Double-booking safety is unchanged (protection comes from the booking existing, not from acceptance). Pro commitment risk already exists today with pending → auto doesn't worsen it; mitigations = prominent Cancel + (post-launch) auto-no-show (migration 032 infra) + report-client/`is_flagged`; the pro's real gate is AVAILABILITY (only publish slots you'll honor; WhatsApp-only pros expose no calendar). **MUST-FIX regardless (more urgent under auto):** the double-booking guard is a NON-ATOMIC check-then-insert with NO unique constraint (confirmed: no slot unique index exists) → concurrent requests can double-book; add a **partial unique index** on `(professional_id, scheduled_date, scheduled_time) WHERE status IN ('pending','confirmed','in_progress') AND scheduled_date IS NOT NULL` so the occupy is atomic. Edge cases all clean (cancel frees; silent client → pro frees; race → 409; slotless/open solicitud → no calendar impact). "Confirmada" copy should mean "slot reserved — coordina por WhatsApp", not "pro approved you". Optional future: a per-pro "requiere aprobación" toggle (default off) — skip for launch. **No code changed — owner to decide before implementing.**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-21 (sprint 382 - **DECISION (analysis-only, no code change): keep the TWO-MODE panel switch; do NOT revert to an all-in-one panel** (design guide). The owner asked to compare A (everything in one panel — seeking + offering together, no switch) vs B (current two-mode switch) given the expectation that **many users use BOTH sides**, with the app launching soon. **Analysis grounded in actual content:** offering side = **7 heavy sections** (pro profile form, Servicios, Casos de éxito gallery, Disponibilidad calendar, Solicitudes recibidas, Oportunidades, Verificación); seeking side = **4 light ones** (Mi perfil básico, Mis solicitudes, Mis solicitudes publicadas, Mis favoritos); shared = 3. **All-in-one would be ~13 items mixing two contexts** — strictly worse for **seek-only users** (forced to see 7 unused/locked offering tools, or hide them = the switch without the switch) and cluttered for **both-sides users** (heavy business tools next to lightweight hiring lists). The "many use both sides" expectation is the strongest argument FOR separation, not against it (Airbnb traveling/hosting, ML compras/ventas separate for the same reason). The mode model's one weakness (not noticing the other side needs you) is already covered by the **unified notifications stream** (shared across modes, tagged "Como profesional"/"Como cliente"). **RECOMMENDATION = keep B**; confident + already in place, so NO code change. Optional future polish (NOT applied — state/query risk the owner asked to avoid): an attention dot on the inactive mode when its side has pending items, and remembering the last tab per mode. Documented in the design guide ("Why TWO MODES, not one all-in-one panel").**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-21 (sprint 381 - **Panel mode-switch labels: "Usar servicios"/"Ofrecer servicios" → first-person "Busco servicios"/"Ofrezco servicios"** (messages es+en). _Last updated: 2026-06-21 (sprint 380 - **BUG fix (one-account model): the phone entered at "Ofrezco servicios" registration is now SHARED with "Busco servicios" mode (account-level), not siloed on the offering profile** (`api/register/professional/route.ts`, `basic-profile-section.tsx`). **Cause:** at pro registration the contact number was written ONLY to **`professionals.whatsapp`** (the public/offering field), never to the account-level **`profiles.phone`** that seeking surfaces read (via `get_my_profile`). (2) **`BasicProfileSection`** (seeker "Mi perfil") now mirrors the booking/publish fallback: if `profiles.phone` is empty, read `professionals.whatsapp`, pre-fill it, and backfill `profiles.phone` — covers accounts created before this fix. **Coverage check:** the **booking modal** (request a service) and **publish-solicitud modal** ALREADY had the whatsapp→phone fallback (sprint 369), so all seeking surfaces now resolve the shared phone. **Other basic data was already shared, not siloed:** name (`profiles.full_name`), photo (`profiles.avatar_url`), cédula, email all live on the single `profiles` row read/written by BOTH modes (pro `ProfileEditor` + seeker `BasicProfileSection` + the pro header join). Consistent with "asked once, saved, reused" — now across both modes of the one account. tsc + next build clean. **Live-verify: register via "Ofrezco servicios" with a phone → switch to "Busco servicios" → Mi perfil shows that phone (pre-filled, not asked again); booking/publishing as a seeker pre-fills it too; name/photo/cédula identical in both modes; EN; ~360px.**_

So this is a **reframe of wording + navigation**, mapping existing accounts with zero risk: a current **client → seeks**, a current **professional → offers + seeks (both)**. **APPLIED:** **(1) Role chooser** ("¿Cómo quieres usar ContrataCR?"): "Busco profesionales" → **"Busco servicios"**, "Soy profesional" → **"Ofrezco servicios"** (descriptions reworded to actions + broader categories incl. salud/clases); added a **`bothNote`** under the chooser ("Puedes hacer ambas cosas: agrega la otra opción cuando quieras desde tu panel.") on both `/registro` + `/onboarding` so nobody feels boxed in. **(2) Panel group headings** (unified pro dashboard): `groupPro` "Mi perfil profesional" → **"Ofrezco servicios"**, `groupClient` "Contratar servicios" → **"Busco servicios"**; the nav menu `hireServices` → **"Busco servicios"** too. Panel title stays **"Mi panel"**. **REGISTRATION decision:** start with ONE action, add the other later (NOT a heavy combined "both at once" flow) — picking "Ofrezco servicios" routes to the full pro signup, "Busco servicios" to the lightweight client signup. **CONVERSION (both directions):** add offering = the existing **"Ofrecer mis servicios"** CTA → `/registro/profesional` (seeker → both, data preserved); add seeking = already present (every pro's unified panel has the "Busco servicios" group). **TERMINOLOGY:** **KEPT "profesional"** (industry standard, dignifies informal trades) — the ACTION labels organize the panel/chooser, while the **person NOUNS stay**: the offerer sees the seeker as **"cliente"** (Solicitudes recibidas / Oportunidades / propuestas), the seeker sees the offerer as **"profesional"** (search / propuestas). EN: "Looking for services" / "Offering services". **DEFERRED (deliberately, per the safety brief):** a literal capability-flag column (`offers_services`/`seeks_services`) — unnecessary since role + professional-profile already encode it, and adding it would be a risky migration for no functional gain; also deferred a combined "register as both at once" flow (start-with-one + add-later is cleaner/lighter). NO routes/ids/DB/component names changed. tsc + next build clean; JSON valid. **Live-verify: /registro + /onboarding → "Busco servicios" / "Ofrezco servicios" + the "puedes hacer ambas" note; a professional's "Mi panel" → groups read "Ofrezco servicios" / "Busco servicios"; a client still sees "Ofrecer mis servicios" to add offering; existing accounts unaffected; the other party is still "cliente"/"profesional" where named; EN; ~360px.**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-20 (sprint 345 - **Password fields: ROOT-CAUSE fix for the "two eyes" + "inverted" reports — hid the browser's NATIVE reveal control** (`globals.css`). The reported bugs (login eye "inverted", registration shows TWO eyes) were NOT in our JSX — our custom toggle is correct everywhere (`show ? <Eye/> : <EyeOff/>`, sprint 338) and the shared `Input` renders only the `rightIcon` we pass (no built-in eye). The real cause is **Edge/IE rendering a native `::-ms-reveal` reveal button** inside every `<input type="password">` on Windows: it sits next to OUR eye (→ "two eyes"), and it toggles the field's visibility WITHOUT updating our icon (→ our icon looks "inverted"/out of sync). FIX: one global CSS rule — `input::-ms-reveal, input::-ms-clear { display: none; }` — so the native control never shows and each field has EXACTLY ONE eye (our correct custom toggle). No JSX change needed (the toggle logic was already right). Covers every password field app-wide (login, registro cliente/profesional, booking modal, reset-password, account change-password). next build clean. **Live-verify (on Edge/Windows): every password field shows ONE eye — slashed when hidden, open when visible, never two, never inverted; login + registration + reset + change password all consistent; ~360px.**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-19 (sprint 331 - **Zonas/publicar-proyecto dropdowns: options were CUT OFF — popup now PORTALED so it's never clipped (provincia shows all, cantón scrolls)** (`select-menu.tsx`, design guide). _Last updated: 2026-06-19 (sprint 329 - **BUG FIX: an old email is freed for reuse after an email change — self-healing signup + authoritative checks + cleanup** (`lib/auth/reconcile-profile-email.ts` NEW, `register/client`, `register/professional`, `check-availability`, `067_resync_profiles_email_cleanup.sql` NEW). **ROOT CAUSE (confirmed):** the blocker is a **stale `profiles.email`**, NOT Auth. `idx_profiles_email_unique` (migration 007) reserves the OLD email on a leftover profiles row after an email change; a new signup reusing that — free in Auth — email collides on the index → `email_taken` + rollback. Auth (`auth.users.email`) is the real source of truth. Sync mechanisms already existed (migration 065 trigger + the `/auth/callback` mirror) but only help FUTURE changes and pre-existing stale rows lingered. **FIXES:** (1) **Self-healing signup** — new `reconcileProfileEmail(admin, email)`: on an email-unique collision, look up EVERY profiles row holding the email against `auth.users` and **re-sync a stale row to its real auth email**, **delete a confirmed orphan**, or treat a still-matching row as a **genuine duplicate** (transient/unknown → leave untouched, treat as taken — never corrupts data); both `register/client` + `register/professional` now reconcile then **RETRY** the upsert, so a freed email registers without any migration. register/professional also now returns a proper `email_taken`/409 (was mislabeled "cédula"). (2) **Authoritative inline check** — `check-availability` no longer reports `emailTaken` from a bare `profiles.email` match; it confirms the matching row's **auth user STILL uses that email** (a stale/orphan match reads as available), matching the signup behavior. (3) **Cleanup migration 067** — re-syncs every profile to its current auth email + deletes orphans, freeing ALL currently-stale emails at once. **TO CLEAN UP EXISTING STALE ROWS: run migration 067 in Supabase** (idempotent; the file includes an inspect query). tsc + next build clean. **Live-verify: change account A's email A→B (confirm); then register a NEW account with email A → succeeds (no "ya registrado"); the inline email check shows A as available; B stays taken; after running migration 067, any previously-stuck old email is reusable.**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-19 (sprint 319 - **Full name: confirmed stored COMPLETE (incl. middle), abbreviated only at display; synced the one Auth-vs-profiles gap** (`run-verification.ts`). **INVESTIGATION findings:** (1) **Storage is the FULL name** — the name written to `profiles.full_name` is the official padrón name `titleCaseName([nombre, papellido, sapellido])` (first + middle given names + both surnames), set by `run-verification.ts` (pro) and the booking cédula-confirmation (client, `booking-modal.tsx` → `profiles.update({full_name: officialName})`). **`proDisplayName()`** (drops the MIDDLE given name → "Isaac Alberto Sánchez Monge" → "Isaac Sánchez Monge") is used **ONLY at DISPLAY** (the public profile `profesionales/[slug]`), never before a DB write — so the DB keeps the complete name and abbreviation is purely cosmetic. _Last updated: 2026-06-19 (sprint 313 - **Navbar photo flash FIXED at the ROOT: the SOCIAL (Google/Facebook) photo no longer paints before the ContrataCR photo** (`hooks/use-auth.ts`). **KEY CLUE (from the user):** for quick-login accounts the navbar first showed the **Google/Facebook** avatar (from `user_metadata.avatar_url`/`picture`) for ~1s, THEN switched to the app photo. ROOT CAUSE: `syncAvatar` SEEDED `avatarUrl` synchronously from `metaAvatar` (the social photo) and flipped `avatarReady` true immediately, then the `profiles.avatar_url` fetch resolved the app photo → the visible **social→app swap**. FIX: **`profiles.avatar_url` is now the source of truth.** The social photo is NO LONGER a seed — it's only a **fallback** used when the account has NO app photo (`finalUrl = profiles.avatar_url || social || null`). The instant seed now comes ONLY from the per-user **localStorage cache** (the app's own resolved avatar from the last session); with no cache (first login) the **neutral skeleton holds** until the fetch resolves — we never paint the social photo first. **Also closed the image-download window:** on a first login (no cache) we **`preloadImage(finalUrl)`** (resolves on load/error/2s timeout) BEFORE flipping `avatarReady`, so when the navbar swaps skeleton→Avatar the photo paints INSTANTLY — never an initials/empty circle mid-download. Warm reloads (cache shown + image in HTTP cache) are unchanged/instant. Net: from login the navbar shows skeleton → the ContrataCR photo, NEVER the Google/Facebook photo and NEVER the empty circle. No navbar changes needed (the skeleton already gates on `avatarReady`). tsc + next build clean. **Live-verify: log in with a Google/Facebook account that has an app photo → navbar shows a neutral skeleton then the ContrataCR photo, with NO ~1s Google/Facebook photo flash and no empty circle; an account with no app photo falls back to the social photo (no flash); manual accounts + warm reloads unaffected.**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-19 (sprint 312 - **BUG FIX: a 2nd booking for a multi-profession pro now re-asks which service (no page refresh needed)** (`booking-modal.tsx`). For a pro with multiple professions, the booking modal asks WHICH service first (`needsProfessionPick = !effectiveCategory && proProfessions.length > 1`, driven by `pickedCategory`). The modal stays **MOUNTED** between bookings, and the open-reset effect (keyed on `open`) reset everything EXCEPT `pickedCategory` — so after the first booking set it, the 2nd booking still had `effectiveCategory` = the first pick → `needsProfessionPick = false` → the service-selection step was skipped/locked until a full refresh (which re-ran the `useState` initializer). FIX: the reset effect now also re-seeds `pickedCategory` with the SAME initializer logic — `initialCategoryId ?? (proProfessions.length === 1 ? proProfessions[0] : null)` — so a category context still wins, a single-profession pro auto-picks, and a multi-profession pro with no context resets to `null` → re-prompts. Doesn't affect the single-profession case or the DOB/health logic (DOB derives from `effectiveCategory`, which now resets correctly). tsc clean. **Live-verify: multi-profession pro → book service A → without refreshing, start another booking → it asks which service again (can pick B); single-profession pro still skips straight to the calendar; a /buscar card opened with a category context still pre-selects it; health DOB still gated on the chosen service.**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-19 (sprint 308 - **Removed the unused padrón birth-date column (`fecha_nacimiento`)** (`066_padron_drop_dob.sql` NEW, `identity-verifier.ts`, `api/cedula/[id]/route.ts`). **Confirmed UNUSED:** migration 053 added `fecha_nacimiento` to padron/padron_staging + the `padron_lookup` RPC to (optionally) autocomplete a health booking's DOB from the cédula — but the TSE electoral roll has **no birth date** (its date field is the cédula EXPIRY, not a DOB), and the loader (`scripts/load-padron.mjs`) only ever writes `cedula/nombre/papellido/sapellido`, so the column was **always NULL**. Tracing the chain: `padron_lookup` → `identity-verifier.lookup().dob` → `/api/cedula` `dob` → `IdentityField.onResult({dob,isAdult})` → the only consumers (`registro/profesional`) read **`r.found` ONLY** (dob/isAdult ignored); the booking-modal's DOB auto-fill reads the **`beneficiary_dob` table** (manual store), NOT the padrón. So the column carried no data and fed nothing. **DOB lives separately** in `profiles.date_of_birth` + `beneficiary_dob` (migration 064). **REMOVAL:** new **migration 066** drops `fecha_nacimiento` from padron + padron_staging, recreates `padron_lookup` back to its migration-050 shape (nombre/papellido/sapellido — DROP+CREATE since the return type changed), and updates `finalize_padron_swap` to recreate staging without the column. **MUST RUN migration 066 in Supabase.** Code cleanup so nothing references the dropped column: `identity-verifier.lookup` now returns `dob:null, isAdult:true` (electoral roll = 18+), removed the dead `ageFromDob` helper; `/api/cedula` comment updated. The cédula-verification columns (cedula/nombre/papellido/sapellido) + lookup/name behavior are **untouched** — verification is unaffected. tsc clean. **Live-verify (after running 066): cédula lookup at registration still returns the official name; health booking still asks DOB manually (and reuses a saved beneficiary DOB); nothing references fecha_nacimiento.**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-19 (sprint 307 - **BUG FIX: deleting the client phone in Mi perfil now persists (it no longer reappears)** (`phone-input.tsx`, `dashboard/cliente/page.tsx`, `booking-modal.tsx`, `publish-project-modal.tsx`). **ROOT CAUSE:** `PhoneInput.changeNational("")` emitted **`${code}${""}` = `"506"`** (the bare dial code) when the field was cleared — so a "deleted" phone was saved as the truthy string **"506"**, never actually clearing; and a re-fetch (`loadProfile`, fired when the `user` identity changes) could re-seed the OLD phone from the DB **before** the 1s autosave ran, so the number visibly **reappeared**. **FIXES:** (1) `PhoneInput` now emits a **truly empty string** when there are no national digits (new `emit()` used by both `changeNational` + `changeCountry`) — clearing → `onChange("")`. (2) New exported **`hasPhoneNumber(value)`** (≥1 national digit; a bare code/empty = NOT a phone) used so legacy rows already saved as **"506"** read as no-phone: the cliente `saveProfile` stores `hasPhoneNumber(form.phone) ? form.phone : null`; booking-modal only seeds `profilePhone` when `hasPhoneNumber(data.phone)`; the project modal's `needsPhone` uses it too. (3) `loadProfile` no longer **clobbers an in-progress edit** — it only re-seeds `profileForm` when `!profileDirtyRef.current`, so a re-fetch can't restore the old phone mid-clear. Net: clearing the phone in Mi perfil → saves `null` → stays empty on reload → the next project/booking asks for it again (the agreed lifecycle); editing still persists. No DB/migration change (the bug was client-side). tsc clean. **Live-verify: Mi perfil → clear the phone → Guardado → reload → still empty (no reappear); create a project/booking → it asks for the phone again; edit the phone → new value persists; self booking still requires a complete phone; ~360px + EN clean.**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-19 (sprint 284 - **Admin verification: state-aware actions (no redundant Rechazar vs Revocar)** (`admin/admin-case.tsx`; admin is internal, Spanish-only). A VERIFIED account previously showed BOTH "Rechazar" (`status !== "rejected"`) AND "Revocar verificación" (`status === "verified"`) — both opened the same reject flow — plus "Volver a pendiente" (`status !== "pending"`); three overlapping actions. Now the available action matches the state: **PENDIENTE** → "Marcar verificado" + "Rechazar" (reject-with-reason → oculto); **VERIFICADA** → ONLY "Revocar verificación" (styled like the reject button, filled red, → `decide("revert_pending")` = back to pending/sin verificar, NOT hidden, no reason); **RECHAZADA** → "Marcar verificado" + "Volver a pendiente". So `Rechazar` is gated `status !== "verified" && status !== "rejected"`, `Revocar` is `status === "verified"` and now reverts to pending (was opening the reject reason flow), and `Volver a pendiente` is `status === "rejected"` (was `!== "pending"`). No two buttons do the same thing. tsc + next build clean. **Live-verify in /admin: a pending pro shows Verificar + Rechazar; a verified pro shows ONLY "Revocar verificación" (red) that returns it to pendiente; a rejected pro shows Verificar + Volver a pendiente.**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-19 (sprint 278 - **Email sync: profiles.email now follows auth.users.email → freed emails are reusable** (`auth/callback/route.ts`, migration 065). **⚠️ RUN IN SUPABASE: `supabase/migrations/065_sync_profiles_email.sql`.** ROOT CAUSE of "Este correo ya está registrado" for an email that is FREE in Supabase Auth (e.g. `isanchezm421@gmail.com`): migration 007 put a partial UNIQUE INDEX `idx_profiles_email_unique` on `profiles.email`; migration 003's `handle_new_user` trigger fills it on INSERT only; NOTHING updated `profiles.email` when an account CHANGED its email, so the OLD email lingered in `profiles`. A new signup with that (now-free-in-Auth) email then collided with the STALE profiles row → the register route mapped the unique violation to `email_taken` → false "ya está registrado". FIX (DB-level, authoritative): (1) **new AFTER UPDATE OF email trigger on `auth.users`** (`on_auth_user_email_change` → `handle_user_email_change()` SECURITY DEFINER) mirrors every future email change into `profiles.email` — no app code can forget it. (2) **one-time BACKFILL** re-syncs all existing rows (`update profiles set email = auth.users.email where distinct`), so already-stale emails become reusable immediately (`isanchezm421@gmail.com` is freed once the migration runs). The register duplicate check (route unchanged) is now accurate because `profiles.email` faithfully mirrors auth. ALSO app-level belt-and-suspenders: `/auth/callback`'s email_change finalize now updates `profiles.email = u.email` via the admin client right after `verifyOtp`, so the CURRENT change syncs even before the trigger is deployed (idempotent if both run). **MANUAL CLEANUP:** running the migration's backfill fixes the changed-email case automatically; a TRULY orphaned profile (auth user deleted, profile remained) is normally impossible (`profiles.id` FK is ON DELETE CASCADE) but if one exists the migration comments include the `left join auth.users … is null` query to find + delete it. tsc + next build clean. **Live-verify (after migration): change an account's email → profiles.email updates in sync; register again with the old (now free) email → succeeds, no false "ya está registrado".**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-18 (sprint 258 - **FIXED the email-change confirmation for real — switched the template to the `token_hash` flow `/auth/callback` was already built for** (`supabase/email-templates/change-email.html`, `account-security.tsx`, `auth/callback/route.ts`, template README). ROOT CAUSE (confirmed by code review): the template shipped **`{{ .ConfirmationURL }}`** (PKCE **code** flow) but `route.ts` (lines ~51-68) only finalizes email change via **`verifyOtp` for `token_hash` + `type=email_change`** — they contradicted, so the verify link fell back to the **Site URL** and stranded the user on **`/es?code=…`**; nothing exchanged the code, the account tab was never reached, `refreshSession()` never ran, and the new email didn't show without a full re-login. FIX: (1) **change-email.html** — both the button and the fallback link now point to **`{{ .SiteURL }}/auth/callback?token_hash={{ .TokenHash }}&type=email_change`** (self-built token_hash link; no `{{ .ConfirmationURL }}`). token_hash needs **no PKCE code_verifier** (survives Outlook/scanner prefetch + other-device opens) and **no redirect_to allowlist**, so it always reaches `/auth/callback`. (2) **account-security `performEmailChange`** — stashes the UI locale in `user_metadata.email_change_locale` (a static Supabase template can't know it) via `updateUser({ email, data: { email_change_locale: locale } }, { emailRedirectTo })`; `emailRedirectTo` kept only as a harmless fallback. (3) **route.ts email_change branch** — now reads `u.user_metadata?.email_change_locale` (`en`→`/en`, else `/es`) and redirects to **`/{locale}/dashboard/{panel}?tab=cuenta&emailChanged=1`** (was hardcoded `/es`), which triggers the account page's existing `refreshSession()` → new email shows WITHOUT logout/login. The route's tolerant handler still resolves the user from `data.user ?? getUser()` so a scanner-consumed token still lands on the account tab. tsc + next build clean. **⚠️ MUST DEPLOY IN SUPABASE:** the template lives in Supabase config, not just the repo — paste the new `change-email.html` into **Authentication → Email Templates → Change Email Address → Save**; ensure **Site URL = `https://contratacr.com`** and **"Secure email change" is OFF** (Authentication → Providers/Settings) so a single click applies the change. **Live-verify: change email → click "Confirmar cambio" → lands on `/{locale}/dashboard/{panel}?tab=cuenta` with the green "correo actualizado" banner, new email shown immediately, NO re-login.**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-18 (sprint 252 - **ACTUAL root cause of email-change "lands on main": sprint 250 REMOVED `emailRedirectTo`, so GoTrue sent the confirmation code to the SITE URL root (`/es?code=…`) instead of `/auth/callback`** (`account-security.tsx` + reverted `change-email.html`/README). _Last updated: 2026-06-18 (sprint 251 - **Email change applied but landed on the MAIN page — `/auth/callback` now handles `email_change` FIRST + TOLERANTLY** (`auth/callback/route.ts`). After sprint 250 the change APPLIES, but the user still landed on the home page. TRACE: the only way to reach the home page is the callback's final `return redirect("/es?auth=error")` fallback — reached when `(code||tokenHash)` is set but `error` is truthy / `data.user` is null. (Confirmed it's NOT the proxy: the auth gate redirects to `/login` or `/onboarding`, never `/`; and a SUCCESS redirect to the cuenta tab can't reach main.) ROOT CAUSE: **email security scanners (Outlook/corporate link-prefetch) hit the link and CONSUME the single-use `token_hash` before the human clicks**, so on the real click `verifyOtp` ERRORS even though the email already changed → previously fell through to the error/main page. RELATED to the login-→-main bug only in symptom (both fall through to "main" on a non-happy path); the MECHANISM differs (that was `?redirect=` precedence — sprint 248; this is the error fallback). FIX: handle `type === "email_change"` **before** the `if (!error && data.user)` guard and **tolerantly** — resolve the user from the verify result `?? (await supabase.auth.getUser()).data.user` (the existing session, since the change was requested while logged in) and redirect role-aware to `/es/dashboard/{profesional|cliente}?tab=cuenta&emailChanged=1` (the green `emailApplied` banner). If there's NO session in this browser (token consumed + logged out here), redirect to `/es/login` (change already applied → sign in with the new email) — NEVER the main page. The `code` path (OAuth/reset) is byte-identical (the email_change block just moved out of the guard; `getUser()` is only called when `data.user` is null, so the happy path is unchanged). No template/Supabase action needed (the sprint-250 token_hash template already works — the email applies). tsc + next build clean. **Live-verify: change email → confirm from the new inbox → email updates AND you land on Cuenta y seguridad with "Tu correo se actualizó" (not main), even if a scanner prefetched the link; OAuth + reset still fine.**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-18 (sprint 250 - **ROOT-CAUSE fix: email change "confirmed but not applied + lands on main page" — the callback only handled `?code=`, but an email-change link is a `token_hash`/`type=email_change` OTP flow that needs `verifyOtp`** (`auth/callback/route.ts`, `account-security.tsx`, `supabase/email-templates/change-email.html` + README). DEEP TRACE: `updateUser({ email })` makes Supabase send the confirm email; the link (template) decides the rest. `/auth/callback` had a single `if (code) { exchangeCodeForSession }` branch — for OAuth + password reset (which DO arrive with a PKCE `code`). An **email-change confirmation does NOT carry a `code`** — it's an OTP-link flow (`token_hash` + `type=email_change`) finalized by **`verifyOtp`**. So the callback's `if (code)` was false → it fell straight through to `return redirect("/es?auth=error")` = **the main page**, and the change was **never finalized** (verifyOtp never called). Exactly the two symptoms. FIX (Supabase's recommended SSR pattern — `token_hash`, NOT `{{ .ConfirmationURL }}`/PKCE which is unreliable for email links: needs the `code_verifier` cookie + redirect_to allowlist): (1) **`change-email.html`** link is now **`{{ .SiteURL }}/auth/callback?token_hash={{ .TokenHash }}&type=email_change`** (both the button + fallback). (2) **`/auth/callback`** now reads `token_hash`/`type`; runs **`verifyOtp({ type, token_hash })`** when a `token_hash` is present (else `exchangeCodeForSession(code)` as before — OAuth/reset UNCHANGED); on a `type === "email_change"` success it redirects **role-aware** to `/es/dashboard/{profesional|cliente}?tab=cuenta&emailChanged=1` (the existing green `emailApplied` banner). Imports `EmailOtpType`. (3) **`account-security.sendEmailChange`** simplified to `updateUser({ email })` (dropped the now-pointless `emailRedirectTo`/role/next — the template + callback own the destination). The token_hash flow needs **no `code_verifier`** (works from any device/browser) and **no redirect_to allowlist**. **ACTION REQUIRED IN SUPABASE: re-paste `change-email.html` into Authentication → Email Templates → Change Email Address, and ensure Site URL = `https://contratacr.com`** (the link is `{{ .SiteURL }}/auth/callback…`). Redirect URLs still need `https://contratacr.com/**` for OAuth/reset, but email change no longer depends on it. tsc + next build clean. **Live-verify: change email → confirm from the NEW inbox → the email IS updated AND you land on Cuenta y seguridad with "Tu correo se actualizó" (NOT the main page); password reset + Google/manual login still work.**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-18 (sprint 248 - **BUG fix: login landed on the MAIN PAGE instead of the panel — a generic `?redirect=` (from the sprint-246 navbar change) was overriding the role-based dashboard redirect** (`login/page.tsx`, `landing-navbar.tsx`). ROOT CAUSE: sprint 246 made the navbar "Ingresar" link `/login?redirect=${pathname}`. `/login`'s post-login logic honored ANY path-like `redirect` (`redirectParam.startsWith("/")`) BEFORE the role-based dashboard fallback — so clicking "Ingresar" from the home page sent `redirect=/` and login navigated back to `/` (main page) instead of the dashboard; same for OAuth (`oauthCallbackUrl` set `next=/`). It hit BOTH manual + Google, client + pro. FIX: added a **`meaningfulRedirect(raw)`** gate in `/login` — a `?redirect=` is honored ONLY when it targets an **authenticated** area: a **`/dashboard` deep-link** (the proxy's `redirectToLogin` preserves these for gated pages — incl. support-ticket links `/es/dashboard/{panel}?tab=soporte&ticket=…` and the proxy `PROTECTED_PREFIXES=["/dashboard"]`) or the **"projects"** alias (publicar-proyecto CTA). A generic/PUBLIC target (`/`, `/buscar`, a profile, etc.) → returns null → falls through to the **role-based dashboard** (`/dashboard/${role === "professional" ? "profesional" : "cliente"}`). Applied the SAME gate to `oauthCallbackUrl` so Google login carries only a meaningful `next` (else empty → callback role-resolves to the panel). ALSO simplified the navbar: `loginHref = "/login"` (no `redirect` param — the navbar only sits on public pages, so it never has a meaningful target; removed the now-unused `pathname`/`usePathname` in that component, kept in the language toggle). PRESERVED EXACTLY: `waitForAuthCookie` cookie-race wait, role resolution (user_metadata→profiles→professionals), OAuth `next` URL-encoding, `flow=oauth` one-method block, `?redirect=` deep-links for tickets/gated pages (still honored — they ARE /dashboard paths). `/auth/callback` untouched (it only ever receives a meaningful or empty `next` now). tsc + next build clean. **Live-verify: "Ingresar" from home/any public page → log in (manual or Google, client or pro) → lands on the correct DASHBOARD (not main); a support-ticket email link while logged out → /login → still lands on the open ticket; "Publicar proyecto" logged-out → projects section.**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-18 (sprint 247 - **SERIOUS auth fix: Google sign-in no longer hijacks an existing manual (email+password) account — enforce ONE email = ONE method, BLOCK mixing** (`auth/callback/route.ts`, `login/page.tsx`, `account-security.tsx`, `auth.login` messages es+en). ROOT CAUSE: OAuth had NO guard. When Google returned a verified email matching an existing manual account, Supabase GoTrue **auto-linked** the Google identity onto that account during `exchangeCodeForSession` (and for an UNCONFIRMED manual account could take over the email). Result: the account flipped to "Google", the callback saw no `onboarding_completed` → routed to NEW-USER ONBOARDING, `account-security` saw a google identity → showed the "usa inicio rápido" guide, and password login appeared lost. DECISION (per user): **BLOCK, do not link.** FIX — **callback guard** (`/auth/callback`): `/login`'s OAuth buttons now hit `/auth/callback?flow=oauth&next=…` (the new `flow=oauth` marker; `next` stays URL-encoded — the fragile bit we must not break). After the code exchange, if `flow=oauth` AND the just-authenticated user ALSO has an **`email` (password) identity** (`data.user.identities.some(i => i.provider === "email")`), we **refuse the session** (`supabase.auth.signOut()`) and redirect to `/es/login?autherror=use_password` — so the OAuth never attaches/takes over, the password account stays intact, and the user is NOT sent to onboarding. A BRAND-NEW Google user (no password identity) passes through normally to onboarding (unchanged). `/login` reads `?autherror=use_password` and shows **`blockedUsePassword`** ("Esta cuenta se creó con correo y contraseña. Inicia sesión con tu contraseña." / EN "This account was created with email and password. Sign in with your password."). REVERSE direction (manual login on a Google account) was ALREADY blocked by `/login`'s `detectSocialOnly` → `socialOnly` message ("Esta cuenta usa inicio de sesión con {provider}…") — left intact. ALSO fixed `account-security` OAuth detection: an account with an `email` identity is now treated as MANUAL (`hasPasswordIdentity` short-circuits `isOAuthAccount`), so a legacy mixed account shows the email/password controls again (truthful UI) instead of the Google guide. PRESERVED EXACTLY: role-aware post-login routing, `waitForAuthCookie`, OAuth `next` encoding, `?redirect=` deep-links, signup OTP. **RECOVERY of already-affected accounts** (Supabase SQL editor / Auth dashboard): find the email in **Authentication → Users**; if it has BOTH email+google identities, run `delete from auth.identities where user_id='<uuid>' and provider='google';` to restore it to password-only (the user then logs in with the original password, or resets via "¿Olvidaste tu contraseña?"); if the manual account was fully replaced by a Google-only user (no password identity), either delete that user and have them re-register manually, or set a password for it (Auth → Users → edit) to regain password access. **SUPABASE CONFIG to set:** (1) ensure **Authentication → Providers → Email → "Confirm email" is ON** so manual accounts are always confirmed and can't be taken over while unconfirmed; (2) if their Supabase version exposes an automatic-identity-linking control, disabling it is belt-and-suspenders, but the callback guard is authoritative and version-independent. NOTE: the guard signs out post-link (it can't prevent GoTrue's link mid-exchange), so a blocked account may retain a stray google identity row until the recovery SQL is run — login still works via password and the UI is truthful. tsc + next build clean. **Live-verify: manual account → log out → "Continuar con Google" same email → bounced to /login with "Inicia sesión con tu contraseña", manual account intact, password works, NOT onboarding; brand-new Google email → normal onboarding; Google account → manual login shows "usa Google".**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-18 (sprint 245 - **BUG: account email change "confirmed but not applied" — root cause is Supabase "Secure email change" (double confirmation); code now returns the confirm link to the app + shows applied/pending feedback** (`account-security.tsx`, `accountSecurity` messages es+en, `supabase/email-templates/change-email.html`). FLOW INSPECTED: `sendEmailChange` → `supabase.auth.updateUser({ email })` (PKCE/`@supabase/ssr`); the **Change Email Address** template uses `{{ .ConfirmationURL }}` → GoTrue `/verify?type=email_change` applies the change server-side then redirects to `redirect_to`; `/auth/callback` exchanges the `?code=` to refresh the session. **ROOT CAUSE (Supabase config, NOT a code bug in the request): "Secure email change" is ON by default** (Dashboard → Authentication → **Providers → Email** [a.k.a. Sign In/Up → Email] → **"Secure email change"**). When ON, GoTrue sends the confirmation to **BOTH** the OLD and the NEW address and applies the change **only after BOTH are confirmed**. The app's UX assumed a SINGLE confirmation, the user confirmed one inbox → the change never applied (account kept the old email). Compounding: `updateUser` passed **no `emailRedirectTo`**, so the link returned to the Supabase **Site URL root** (no session refresh, no feedback). **WHAT THE USER MUST DO IN SUPABASE (pick one):** (A) **RECOMMENDED — turn "Secure email change" OFF** → a single confirmation from the NEW email applies it (matches the app's one-link UX); or (B) keep it ON → users MUST click the link in BOTH inboxes (the UI/template now say so). ALSO ensure **Authentication → URL Configuration → Redirect URLs** includes **`https://contratacr.com/auth/callback`** (and the localhost dev origin) — already used by OAuth + password reset, so usually present; and the **Site URL** is `https://contratacr.com`. **CODE FIX:** (1) `updateUser({email}, { emailRedirectTo })` where `emailRedirectTo = ${origin}/auth/callback?next=/${locale}/dashboard/${role}?tab=cuenta&emailChanged=1` (role from `user.user_metadata.role`, default cliente) → after confirming, the existing callback exchanges the code (refreshing the session to the NEW email) and lands on the **Cuenta y seguridad** tab; (2) that tab detects `?emailChanged=1` and shows a green **`emailApplied`** "Tu correo se actualizó correctamente" banner (then strips the param via `history.replaceState`); (3) reworded `emailSent`/`emailConfirmHelp` (es+en) to tell users they may need to confirm from **both** their current and new email; (4) added a line to `change-email.html` explaining the same (re-paste into Supabase to take effect). NO change to `/auth/callback` (it already handles the `code` generically — OAuth/reset path untouched). tsc + next build clean. **Live-verify: set "Secure email change" per choice; request a change → see the pending note → click the confirmation link(s) → land on Cuenta y seguridad with the green "se actualizó" banner and the NEW email shown; account email is actually updated.**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-18 (sprint 244 - **"¿Un día distinto?" exception modes: VERIFIED the replace/add precedence is already correct; fixed the misleading message when "horas extra" overlaps the weekly hours** (`availability-editor.tsx` `findOverlapConflict`/`saveException`; new `availabilityEditor.conflictExtraWeekly` es+en). INSPECTION first — all three modes ALREADY interact with the weekly template + materializer exactly as specified: (1) **"Horario distinto ese día" (custom) = REPLACE** — `rangesForLocOnDate` (`base = custom.length ? custom : weekly`) and `computeDesiredSlots` (`base = exDay.custom.length ? exDay.custom : weeklyByKey[loc|wd]`) both use the custom franjas as the base and IGNORE the weekly hours that date. (2) **"Cerrar ese día" (closed) = REPLACE→none** — `rangesForLocOnDate` returns `[]` if any closed row; the materializer `if (exDay?.closed) continue` emits NO slots that date regardless of weekly. (3) **"Agregar horas extra" (extra) = ADD** — both build `franjas = [...base, ...extra]`, so the weekly hours STILL apply that date PLUS the extra; and `saveException` validates extra against the weekly base (`ownBase` = that location's weekly rows for `weekdayOf(date)`) with the half-open `rangesOverlap` (consecutive/adjacent allowed), blocking a real overlap. Modes are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE per (location,date) — `saveException` deletes all of that date's rows before inserting the chosen mode — so when extra is saved the effective base is genuinely the weekly hours (never a leftover custom), making the weekly-base check correct. THE BUG FIXED: when extra overlapped the weekly hours, the blocking modal showed `conflictSelf` ("Las franjas de este día se traslapan entre sí…") — which wrongly says the franjas overlap EACH OTHER, not the weekly schedule. Added a dedicated **`conflictExtraWeekly`** ("Esas horas extra se cruzan con tu horario de siempre de ese día. Agrégalas fuera de tu horario habitual; un horario seguido sí se permite." / EN "Those extra hours overlap your usual hours for that day. Add them outside your regular schedule; back-to-back times are allowed.") and threaded it through `findOverlapConflict` via a new `ownBaseBody` param (the `ownBase`-overlap branch now uses it; `findOverlapConflict` is called ONLY by `saveException`, and `ownBase` is non-empty ONLY for extra, so this targets exactly the extra-vs-weekly case — proposed-vs-proposed self-overlap still says `conflictSelf`). Also hardened the `ownBase` filter with `isCompleteFranja` (skip half-typed weekly drafts). Mode DESCRIPTIONS were already accurate (`optExtraDesc` "Suma horas además…", `optCustomDesc` "Reemplaza tu horario de siempre…", `optClosedDesc` "No aceptas citas…"). No materializer/backend change (it was already correct). tsc + next build clean. **Live-verify: a date with weekly 8AM–5PM → "Horas extra" 4–6PM is BLOCKED with the new "se cruzan con tu horario de siempre" message; 5–7PM (consecutive) is allowed and ADDS; "Horario distinto" 10AM–12PM REPLACES (booking shows only 10–12, not 8–5); "Cerrar" makes the date unavailable; EN correct; ~360px.**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-17 (sprint 229 - **Autocomplete dropdowns: switched from `position:fixed` to `position:absolute` in DOCUMENT coords so they stay ATTACHED below the input (fixes the homepage hero on iOS)** (`landing-hero.tsx` `useAnchoredRect` + its 2 dropdowns; `anchored-dropdown.tsx` `useAnchoredPosition`/`AnchoredDropdown`; `category-search.tsx` + `languages-input.tsx` portal renders). FOUND: the homepage hero is **`LandingHero` (`landing-hero.tsx`)**, NOT `hero-search.tsx` (a separate/unused-on-home component) — so sprint 228 never touched the real hero. The hero (and the rest) used **portal + `position: fixed`**, which pins the panel to the VIEWPORT; on iOS focusing the input opens the keyboard and shifts the visual viewport, so the `fixed` panel floated UP and OVER the field (covering what you type) while the input scrolled down — and it DETACHED on scroll. FIX (shared in `useAnchoredRect` so BOTH the service/profession AND location/address dropdowns get it): portal to `<body>` (still immune to the search-pill's `overflow-hidden`) BUT position **`absolute` in DOCUMENT coords** = `rect.left + scrollX`, `rect.bottom + scrollY` — same coordinate space as the input, so panel + input move together (page scroll, keyboard shift, modal internal scroll via the capture scroll listener) and it always sits DIRECTLY BELOW the field, never over it. Always opens BELOW (dropped flip-up — the requirement is "directly below"); **`maxH` clamped to the space above the keyboard** (`visualViewport.offsetTop+height − rect.bottom`) with **internal scroll** (`overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain`). Same change applied to the shared `useAnchoredPosition`/`AnchoredDropdown` (so /buscar, navbar, /categorias, token inputs, CategorySearch, admin search all stay attached too) — `AnchoredPos` lost `bottom`; `CategorySearch` + `LanguagesInput` portal renders switched `fixed`→`absolute` (dropped `bottom`). Listens to scroll(capture)+resize+`visualViewport` resize/scroll. Logic/selection/keyboard-nav unchanged. tsc + next build clean. **Live-verify ~360px: focus the hero service field, type → list shows DIRECTLY BELOW, input stays visible above it, scroll the page → list stays glued to the input; same for the location/address field.**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-17 (sprint 228 - **Autocomplete dropdowns never cover the field on mobile — ONE shared, keyboard-aware anchored dropdown everywhere** (NEW `components/ui/anchored-dropdown.tsx`; refactored `category-search.tsx`, `languages-input.tsx`, `aseguradoras-input.tsx`, `hero-search.tsx`, `search-filters.tsx`, `category-search-box.tsx`, `admin-user-search.tsx`, `landing-navbar.tsx`; `globals.css` for Google Places). PROBLEM: on ~360px the typing-suggestion dropdowns overlapped the input the user was typing in. ROOT CAUSE was two patterns: (a) several dropdowns were plain `absolute top-full`/`mt-1` lists that an `overflow:hidden`/`transform` ancestor could clip or that sat in-flow oddly; (b) the already-portaled ones (CategorySearch, languages-input) computed space from **`window.innerHeight`**, which on iOS does NOT shrink for the keyboard — so with the keyboard up they thought the area behind it was free, opened DOWN, and the list rendered behind the keyboard / over the field. FIX: one primitive **`useAnchoredPosition(anchorRef, open, maxHeight)`** + **`<AnchoredDropdown>`** — portaled to `<body>` (no ancestor can clip it), `position: fixed` from the field's rect, opens BELOW by default and flips ABOVE only when the **visible** space below (measured with **`window.visualViewport`** height+offset, so the keyboard counts) is too small; max-height clamped to the visible space with internal scroll (`overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain`); recomputes on scroll/resize AND `visualViewport` resize+scroll (keyboard show/hide). The field is NEVER covered. Adopted in ALL typing autocompletes: home **HeroSearch** (service + location), **/buscar** sidebar search + **MobileServiceSearch**, **CategorySearch** (publicar proyecto / filters / registration — category & profession), **LanguagesInput**, **AseguradorasInput**, **AdminUserSearch**, and the **landing navbar** search (`CategoryAutocomplete` + the compact scrolled service & location bars). Google **Places** (`location-picker`/`workplaces-picker`) is Google-positioned (below the input) — added `.pac-container { max-height: 45vh; overflow-y: auto }` so a long list scrolls instead of running off-screen. Selection still works (option `onMouseDown` preventDefault keeps focus; portal doesn't change that); keyboard nav + blur-close unchanged. Desktop unchanged (still opens below). tsc + next build clean. **Live-verify at ~360px: focus each search/autocomplete, type → the suggestion list shows BELOW the field (or above only if truly no room), the input stays visible, the list scrolls if long, and nothing renders behind the keyboard or over the field.**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-17 (sprint 227 - **Admin can APPROVE a suggested category in ONE CLICK → it becomes a live, selectable/searchable category (no code deploy); + edit-before-approve, reject, dupe warning, pending badge** (`admin-categories.tsx`, `api/admin/categories/route.ts`, `api/admin/pending-counts/route.ts`, `admin-shell.tsx`; NEW `api/categories/approved/route.ts`, `lib/data/use-custom-categories.ts`; `lib/data/categories.ts`, `category-search.tsx`, `services-editor.tsx`, `[locale]/layout.tsx`). PROBLEM: the catalog is a **static TS file** (`lib/data/categories.ts`) + a mirror `categories` DB table; the old admin "Aprobar" only flipped `category_suggestions.status` (its own footnote said a DEV had to hand-edit `categories.ts`) — approval did NOTHING functional. NOW approval is real, via a **runtime OVERLAY**: approved `category_suggestions` rows (RLS already allows public read of `approved`) are loaded at runtime and MERGED into the fixed catalog. **Registry in `categories.ts`** (server-safe, no React): `setCustomCategories`/`getCustomCategories`/`getAllCategories`/`subscribeCustomCategories` + `CUSTOM_GROUP_ID="otras"`; **`searchCategories`** now searches fixed+custom, **`getCategoryLabel`** resolves custom labels (and its unknown-id fallback now strips the `sg_` slug prefix → "sg_vendedor_de_botellas" → "Vendedor de botellas"), **`getCategoryGroupLabel`** maps "otras"→"Otras categorías"/"Other categories". **Client load**: `useCustomCategories()` (in `use-custom-categories.ts`) fetches **`GET /api/categories/approved`** ONCE per page-load (module-level, shared) and re-renders subscribers; `CategorySearch` + `services-editor` call it (and `services-editor` uses `getAllCategories()`, `CategorySearch` appends an "Otras categorías" browse group); a global **`<CustomCategoriesLoader/>`** mounted in the locale layout populates the registry app-wide so hero-search / `/categorias` box (which read `searchCategories` directly) also see customs once a user types. **Admin UI** (`admin-categories.tsx`, Spanish-only): pending rows render the name as an **inline-editable input** (correct wording before approving, e.g. "plomeria"→"Plomería"); **Aprobar** (green, 1 click) sends `{status:"approved", label}` → PATCH flags `approved` + (possibly edited) label AND **upserts the row into the `categories` DB table** (es_salud defaults false) so both lists stay in sync; Worse, because `persistDay` validated + wrote on EVERY field change, the TRANSIENT state while editing (start changed to 7:00 AM but end still the default 6:00 PM = a 7 AM–6 PM range) OVERLAPPED the 8–5 block → got blocked → the edit reverted → the pro couldn't pick an earlier free time (7–8 AM). (2) New `isCompleteFranja(f)` = both ends set AND end>start; **only COMPLETE franjas are validated, persisted to `availability_weekly`, and materialized** — INCOMPLETE drafts stay in LOCAL state only (so the UI shows the open row) and never trip the overlap guard nor save. `computeDesiredSlots` + `rangesForLocOnDate` skip incomplete; `copyToAll` copies only complete (no-op if none). (3) Start field has no `min`; end's `min` (start+30) applies only once a start is chosen; the start→end auto-bump fires only when end is already set — so a leftover default never blocks an earlier choice. (4) `dayFranjas` sorts empty drafts LAST. The existing overlap rule still applies to the CHOSEN complete times (true overlaps blocked, adjacent/gap-fill/out-of-range allowed). The "Cambiar un día" modal is untouched (it validates only on its explicit Guardar, not per-keystroke). _Last updated: 2026-06-17 (sprint 218 - **Availability overlap BUG fixed (wrongly blocked gap-fills) + consistency + server-side guard** (`availability-editor.tsx`, new migration 061). ROOT CAUSE of wrong blocking: `otherOccupiedForWeekday` (which feeds the per-day guidance AND `suggestFreeFranja`) read ONLY the recurring `weekly` rows and IGNORED exceptions, while the validator `findOverlapConflict`→`rangesForLocOnDate` INCLUDES them. Repro: Loc A Wed weekly 08:00–14:00 + a one-off "día distinto" extra 16:00–17:00; toggling another location's Wednesday on → smart default saw only 08:00–14:00 occupied → suggested **14:00–17:00**, which the exception-aware validator then BLOCKED (overlaps the 16:00–17:00) → the 14:00–16:00 gap was un-fillable. (The `rangesOverlap` half-open check itself was already correct — touching/gap-fill/out-of-range never overlap; `aS<bE && bS<aE`.) FIX: `otherOccupiedForWeekday` is now the **UNION of `rangesForLocOnDate` across every future date of that weekday** (HORIZON), so guidance + `suggestFreeFranja` + validation ALL use the SAME exception-aware occupancy → the smart default now suggests **14:00–16:00** and it saves. CONSISTENCY: one source of truth (`rangesForLocOnDate`) across regular weekly AND "día distinto"/extra/specific-date paths. SERVER-SIDE (migration 061, **run in Supabase**): BEFORE-INSERT/UPDATE triggers on `availability_weekly` (same weekday) + `availability_exceptions` (same date) reject DIFFERENT-location HALF-OPEN overlaps so it can't be bypassed by a direct write (the editor pre-validates, so the trigger only fires on bypass/pre-existing data; weekly↔exception precedence stays client-side). Verified: 14:00–16:00 allowed beside 08:00–14:00 + 16:00–17:00; out-of-range (before 08:00 / after) allowed; true overlaps still blocked. tsc + next build clean. **Apply 061 in the Supabase SQL editor.**_

Absolute ⇒ ZERO flow space ⇒ cannot push/reflow the title or anything below, ever. `HeaderSaveStatus` (pro, via context) and the client title overlay both use this. `whitespace-nowrap` keeps the label one line; `pointer-events-none` so it never blocks the title. _Last updated: 2026-06-17 (sprint 212 - **Availability: block OVERLAPPING time across locations (can't be in two places at once)** (`availability-editor.tsx`, `availabilityEditor` messages es+en). The editor's source of truth is `availability_weekly` + `availability_exceptions` (per LOCATION), materialized into `availability_slots`. Materialization already deduped EXACT `(date,time)` collisions across locations (first-writer-wins) but did NOT stop overlapping RANGES (e.g. Loc A Mon 10–12 + Loc B Mon 11–13). NOW every save validates first: new helper **`findOverlapConflict(loc, proposed, scope, ownBase)`** + **`rangesOverlap`** (half-open — touching ends like 12–13/13–14 are OK) + **`rangesForLocOnDate`** (effective open ranges for a location on a DATE, applying the SAME precedence as materialization: closed→none, `custom` REPLACES weekly, `extra` ADDS). It blocks: (a) **same-location** overlaps (proposed franjas overlapping each other, or `extra` overlapping this location's own weekly base), and (b) **cross-location** overlaps — proposed checked against EVERY OTHER location on the affected day(s): for a weekly weekday it scans every future date (HORIZON 70d) landing on it (so weekly↔weekly AND weekly↔other-location-exception are caught); for an exception it checks that single date. Wired into **`persistDay`**, **`copyToAll`** (validates all 7 weekdays) and **`saveException`** (now returns `boolean`; the DayModal stays open + resets its Guardar spinner on a blocked save). On conflict: a friendly modal (`conflictTitle` + `conflictCross`{place}/`conflictSelf`, `conflictOk`, no voseo; amber Calendar icon, `z-[210]` above the day modal, Esc/scrim/OK to close) — the state is NOT mutated and NOTHING is written. ENFORCEMENT is at SAVE in the editor (the sole write path; all writes go through these functions), not just visual. Coverage zones + "A domicilio" count as locations too. EXISTING valid availability is untouched (validation only fires on the day being edited, vs OTHER locations — re-saving an unrelated day never trips on a legacy overlap). **PRE-EXISTING overlaps from before this rule are NOT auto-deleted** (per request): they remain and still materialize (with the existing exact-collision dedup); the pro is blocked + guided to fix only when they next edit that exact conflicting day. Detection query to flag them (weekly): `SELECT a.professional_id,a.weekday,a.location_id,b.location_id,a.start_time,a.end_time,b.start_time,b.end_time FROM availability_weekly a JOIN availability_weekly b ON a.professional_id=b.professional_id AND a.weekday=b.weekday AND a.location_id<b.location_id AND a.start_time<b.end_time AND b.start_time<a.end_time;`. SERVER-SIDE note: a DB trigger on the two tables is the bypass-proof option but was deliberately NOT auto-applied to the booking-critical tables (a false-positive would block legitimate saves) — available on request. tsc + next build clean._

_Last updated: 2026-06-17 (sprint 210 - **Logged-in EXISTING account no longer pushed through REGISTRATION** (new `hooks/use-redirect-if-registered.ts`, wired into `registro/page.tsx` + `registro/cliente/page.tsx`). BUG: a user with an active session + existing account could reach the registration/onboarding flow (e.g. support email → "crear cuenta o iniciar sesión" → /login → "registrarte gratis" → `/registro` "¿Cómo quieres usar ContrataCR?" → "Busco profesionales" → `/registro/cliente` "finish registration") — being asked to create an account they already have. ROOT CAUSE: `/registro` (the type-chooser) was a static client page with NO session check, and `/registro/cliente` rendered its "complete profile" form for ANY logged-in `user` without distinguishing an EXISTING complete account from a genuinely-new/incomplete one. (`/registro/profesional` was already guarded — it bounces a user who already has a `professionals` row to `/dashboard/profesional`; and `/onboarding` already self-redirects existing accounts.) FIX: new **`useRedirectIfRegistered()`** hook — detection mirrors `/onboarding` (canonical `user_metadata.onboarding_completed`; fallback `get_my_profile` RPC for pre-flag accounts; reads `role`), heals the metadata flag, then **hard-navigates to the role-aware panel** (`/{locale}/dashboard/{profesional|cliente}`). It only acts on users who **ARRIVED already logged in** (captured once on first auth resolve) so a logged-OUT visitor's in-page email/password signup → OTP → success flow on `/registro/cliente` is never hijacked; an **incomplete** logged-in session (real account row not finished, e.g. OAuth completing a client profile) is LEFT on the page to finish. Returns `checking` → both pages render a spinner (never the form) during the async check, so existing users see NO registration flash before the bounce. NET coherent flow: logged-in + complete → panel; logged-in + incomplete → finish; logged-out → registration. UNTOUCHED: `/registro/profesional` guard, `/onboarding`, `/login` (its form still shows but the moment a logged-in user clicks through to registration they're bounced to their panel). English fine (role-aware, locale-aware). tsc + next build clean. **Live-verify: log in with an existing account, open `/registro` and `/registro/cliente` → bounced to your panel (no chooser, no "finish registration"); a brand-new visitor still registers normally.**_

_Last updated: 2026-06-16 (sprint 197 - **Upload security: block SVG + magic-byte server validation, per context** (`lib/upload-validation.ts` + 4 routes + client accepts). SVG (XML → can embed JS → stored-XSS) was accepted everywhere: client `accept="image/*"` includes svg, and servers only checked `type.startsWith("image/")` or empty type (a renamed/forged-MIME file slipped through); `/api/upload` + `/api/contact` had NO type check. NEW `sniffFileType(buf)` detects the REAL type from **magic bytes** (never the spoofable extension/MIME) → only jpeg/png/webp/gif/heic (+pdf) pass; SVG/HTML/scripts/exe have no safe signature → rejected. `validateUpload(buf,{allow,maxBytes,allowLabel})` applied server-side at EVERY point: `/api/upload/photo` (avatar+casos, images, 10MB), `/api/upload` (images, 10MB), `/api/payments/receipt` (images+pdf, 10MB), `/api/contact` (images+pdf, 4MB each — validated before save/email). Cloudinary data URIs now use the DETECTED kind's MIME. Client `accept` tightened off `image/*` (`IMAGE_ACCEPT`/`IMAGE_DOC_ACCEPT`): photo-gallery, profile-editor, subscription-panel; support-form already specific + a client type-guard with localized `supportForm.errFormat` (es+en). All uploaders surface the server's "Formato no permitido. Usa JPG, PNG o WEBP." tsc + build clean._

_Last updated: 2026-06-16 (sprint 193 - **Support email "Ver conversación" → Google login SUCCEEDS → opens that exact ticket** (`proxy.ts`, `login/page.tsx`, `auth/callback/route.ts`, `support-notify.ts`, `admin/support/route.ts`, `support-tickets.tsx`, both dashboards). BUG: from a reply email's "Ver conversación", a logged-out click → login → Google failed with `/es?auth=error` (only from this path). ROOT CAUSE (two parts): (1) the **proxy redirected the gated dashboard URL to `/login` but DROPPED the target**, and the login page never forwarded it through OAuth — the ticket destination was lost; (2) when a deep-link target was present it was put on the callback URL **UNENCODED**, so its `?tab=…&ticket=…` query merged into `/auth/callback`'s query and **broke the PKCE code exchange** → auth=error; a stale-session visit could also clear the `…-code-verifier` cookie. FIX (carry the target safely end-to-end + open the ticket): proxy → redirect to login with **`?redirect=<path+query>`**, and `clearAuthCookies` now **NEVER deletes the `code-verifier` cookie**; login → a full in-app `?redirect=` path makes password login go straight there and OAuth pass it as a single **URL-ENCODED `next`** (well-formed callback URL); callback → redirect to `next` for INTERNAL paths only (`"/"` not `"//"`); the reply email + bell deep-link are now **role-aware** (`cliente`/`profesional`, via a `profiles.role` lookup) and include **`&ticket=<id>`** (`notifyUserOfReply` takes `panel` + `ticketId`); `SupportTickets` gained **`initialTicketId`** → opens that exact ticket on mount (both dashboards pass `?ticket=`); a ticket that isn't the viewer's falls back to the list gracefully (`/api/support?id=` is owner-scoped; `claimGuestTickets` still attaches same-email guest tickets first, so a guest who just made an account lands on the conversation). **NO Supabase/Google config change needed** — `redirectTo` base stays `/auth/callback` (already allow-listed; query is ignored for redirect-URL matching, same as the working `?next=projects` flow). tsc + build clean._

REMOVED `sendViaSMTP` + the `nodemailer` import + the SMTP env vars; `/api/contact` now sends ONLY via Resend (`sent = await sendViaResend(...)`). The ticket is still SAVED to the admin panel regardless of email success, so nothing is lost if Resend hiccups. NOW every automated app email goes through Resend from the verified `ContrataCR <soporte@contratacr.com>` domain: verification (`verification-notify.ts`), support inbox + user reply (`support-notify.ts`), reports (`api/report`), bell/notification emails (`notifications.ts`), and this new-ticket notification (`api/contact`). **Zoho stays ONLY as a human mailbox** for soporte@contratacr.com (a person can read/reply manually) — the app never sends through it. `nodemailer` left in package.json (harmless, unused). Verification codes untouched (already Resend). tsc + build clean._
